parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, retained gender-reassignment discrimination protection, functioning courts, and a broadly tolerant society lower severity. But the dossier documents state-imposed universal exposures (tier 1): strip-searches by birth sex under new police policies, a statutory single-sex-spaces code in force that UN experts warn institutionalises exclusion, and announced single-sex ward bans — with a documented fatality (Joelle) after ward removal. These follow every outed traveller into custody, facilities and hospital. Anti-trans media hostility and a steep rights decline add street-level friction/hostility (tier 3). Ongoing litigation and surviving protections temper, but do not remove, the exposures. No criminalisation plus documented universal-exposure practices puts this in Elevated Risk, above mid-point but below Reduced Risk.
